verdicts.reason: Both make the same structural mistakes. The VOLTSTRIDE box, which is the hero product, has shrunk to a tiny scrap in the lower left with an unreadable logo. The 48H ONLY badge is pushed out against the left edge. The lime panel has a big dead gap between the headline and the body copy. A's two-line headline fills the panel almost edge to edge, with about 10px of padding, which looks cramped and leaves a larger empty middle. B stacks the headline one word per line, which is awkward, but it keeps proper margins and fills more of the dead space, so B is slightly less bad.
